title: Logo Lockup
slide_intent: Teach when to keep a symbol attached to its name so an unfamiliar audience can learn the association.
strategic_value: Using the two together can build recognition for the revised symbol during its introduction.
demonstration: A small note calls for the symbol and wordmark together for the immediate future. A large color lockup appears to its right on white.
practical_value: Use the paired signature for the introduction described in this edition.

content_islands.name: Adoption guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and short usage note in a narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Lockup specimen
content_islands.spec: Show the full-color carrot and dark wordmark in a single horizontal line on white.
